title: Brain-based Prediction of the Dying Duration in Humans After Withdrawal of Life Sustaining Therapies to Inform Donation After Circulatory Death
official: Brain-based Prediction of the Dying Duration in Humans After Withdrawal of Life Sustaining Therapies to Inform Donation After Circulatory Death
summary: The purpose of this study is to develop a new tool that uses information collected before life-sustaining treatments are withdrawn to better predict whether a patient will die within the time needed for organ donation to be possible. The tool created should help improve planning for organ donation and provide families and healthcare teams with more accurate information.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age ≥ 19;
2. Eligible for DCD

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Complete high cervical spinal cord injury (C5 and above)
2. Pacemaker in situ
3. Tracheostomy
